# Robustness of the round-3 model selection (generated by robustness.py; do not edit by hand)

Selection rule under test: `balanced_maximin` (select_model.py; the selection rule of the article, Section 2.3.5). Inputs: results/structural_scan_components.csv, results/selection/supervised_grid_per_seed.csv. All supervised numbers are matched: each family is evaluated at exactly the configuration and percentile that is its structural best under the setting being tested.

## Headlines

1. Baseline, proposed rule (menu A = the 11 one-vs-rest families, 9 pass the floor): **KNeighborsClassifier** 0.713426; runner-up CalibratedSVC 0.552013; margin 0.161413.
2. Round-2 two-stage rule on the same matched inputs (held-out seed 13): **CalibratedSVC** 0.170437 (stage two, positive score); shortlist CalibratedSVC, LogisticRegression, NearestCentroid, KNeighborsClassifier. KNeighborsClassifier scores 0.000000 there: re-normalized inside the shortlist its CV AUC (0.713486) gets s_auc 0.000000 (shortlist CV AUC range 0.713486 to 0.721132).
3. Other aggregations, menu A, held-out 5-seed mean: equal weights KNeighborsClassifier; three-criterion rank-sum KNeighborsClassifier (sum 9.0); stage-one maximin KNeighborsClassifier; weighted-sum simplex share won by kNN-21 0.812 (KNeighborsClassifier 0.812;LogisticRegression 0.077;SGDClassifier 0.059;RidgeClassifier 0.051); Pareto front CalibratedSVC, LogisticRegression, RidgeClassifier, SGDClassifier, PassiveAggressive, KNeighborsClassifier.
4. Two-criterion rules (structure and CV AUC only), menu A: rank-sum CalibratedSVC and KNeighborsClassifier tied; epsilon rule at 0.008 AUC CalibratedSVC; epsilon rule at 0.075 objective PassiveAggressive; weighted sum: RidgeClassifier for w in [0.0000, 0.1039]; LogisticRegression for w in [0.1040, 0.4050]; KNeighborsClassifier for w in [0.4051, 0.7475]; SGDClassifier for w in [0.7476, 1.0000].
5. Held-out variants, proposed rule, menu A: seed13 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426; mean5 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426; seed14 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426; seed15 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426; seed16 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426; seed17 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426; all_verbs_mean5 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426; all_verbs_seed13 KNeighborsClassifier 0.713426.
6. Held-out variants, two-stage rule, menu A: seed13 CalibratedSVC 0.170437; mean5 CalibratedSVC 0.170437; seed14 CalibratedSVC 0.170437; seed15 NearestCentroid 0.051721; seed16 CalibratedSVC 0.170437; seed17 CalibratedSVC 0.170437; all_verbs_mean5 CalibratedSVC 0.138768; all_verbs_seed13 NearestCentroid 0.051721.
7. Legacy kNN admitted (evaluation-only construction, `Legacy kNN|unweighted|K=15/th=0.28/c=6`, PenalizedObj 1.003666, CV AUC 0.705498, held-out within-one mean 0.739326): proposed rule **Legacy kNN** 0.710330 (runner-up KNeighborsClassifier 0.662454); two-stage rule (seed 13) KNeighborsClassifier 0.307494. Legacy kNN is not eligible because it cannot run the production pipeline (one global vote cutoff, no per-level calibrated scores, not exportable).
8. SCS weights, 500 joint draws, proposed rule menu A: KNeighborsClassifier 486, LogisticRegression 8, SGDClassifier 3, none (no family passes the floor) 2, CalibratedSVC 1. Structural-only rule menu A: SGDClassifier 500; menu B: Legacy kNN 404, SGDClassifier 96. Round-2 two-stage rule (matched, seed 13) menu A: KNeighborsClassifier 274, CalibratedSVC 123, LogisticRegression 98, SGDClassifier 5.
9. SCS weights, 20 single-weight settings, proposed rule menu A: KNeighborsClassifier 20; structural-only menu A: SGDClassifier 20.
10. Of the 500 joint draws, 434 keep all 9 families above the absolute floor; there the proposed rule picks KNeighborsClassifier 433, CalibratedSVC 1. The remaining draws (fewer floor-passing families, because the floor does not rescale with the weights): 0 families: none (no family passes the floor) 2; 1 families: SGDClassifier 2; 2 families: SGDClassifier 1; 7 families: KNeighborsClassifier 12; 8 families: KNeighborsClassifier 41, LogisticRegression 8.
11. Joint draws with Legacy kNN admitted, proposed rule: Legacy kNN 469, KNeighborsClassifier 30, none (no family passes the floor) 1.
12. Guardrails and penalties (19 settings, one change at a time), proposed rule menu A: kNN-21 in 18 of 19; other winners: penalty x0.0 -> LogisticRegression.
13. Smallest single changes that would change the proposed rule's winner (menu A, 5-seed mean): KNeighborsClassifier CV_macro_AUC_mean5 -0.017124 -> CalibratedSVC; RidgeClassifier CV_macro_AUC_mean5 +0.031022 -> CalibratedSVC; LogisticRegression CV_macro_AUC_mean5 +0.032106 -> CalibratedSVC.

Construction: votes against the outer-training verbs; vote sums calibrated per level by an empirical CDF fitted on inner out-of-fold vote sums; hard labels from the vote rule itself (no per-level thresholds, no soft tier). Production cannot use this model.

## 4. SCS weights (robustness_scs_weights.csv, robustness_scs_config_reach.csv)

500 joint draws (numpy default_rng(13); each weight times U(0.5, 1.5) in the order wD, wM, wT, wC, wE) and 20 single-weight settings. Per setting: objective recomputed, each family's best configuration re-selected, matched supervised numbers pulled, rules re-applied. The adequacy floor 0.5 is absolute, on a scale that moves with the weights.
